run_interactive_hosted_server: run the MetaSeq hosted generation API server locally using python -m metaseq.cli.interactive_hosted
run_batching_loop: run the dynamic batching loop to group and execute generation requests in optimized batches
run_worker_main: run the worker main function to load a model and start the Flask generation server
run_completions_endpoint: run a POST request to the /completions endpoint to generate text completions via the API
run_cli_main: run the CLI entry point to launch the hosted web UI for text generation
